rows.grounds: instrumental of śibikā; means of transport
compound dvija + ārūḍha; describes mounted transport
instrumental of gaja; means of transport

items.question: By which conveyances may the consecrated linga be carried in this rite?
items.inference: The linga may be transported by palanquin, brahmin-mounted carriage, or elephant.
uncertainties: The exact referent of dvijārūḍha remains slightly unclear.
items.plain_english: By palanquin, mounted by a brahmin, or by elephant.
